title: SONiC switch
description: SONiC state from redis (sonic-metrics producer): ports, counters, PortChannels, BGP, BFD, LLDP, transceivers, ACL/CoPP, routes, config conflicts, unit restarts.

panels.title: SONiC
panels.description: sonic_up: the producer reached the SONiC redis. No value: no sonic-metrics producer on this job.

panels.title: Ports oper up / admin up
panels.description: Front-panel ports oper up (APPL_DB PORT_TABLE) and admin up.

panels.title: PortChannels up
panels.description: PortChannels oper up / configured.

panels.title: BGP established
panels.description: Established sessions (bgpmon: default VRF only) / neighbors in CONFIG_DB BGP_NEIGHBOR (all VRFs).

panels.title: BFD sessions up
panels.description: Software BFD sessions Up / all (STATE_DB BFD_SESSION_TABLE, bfdsyncd).

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: Routes in APPL_DB ROUTE_TABLE (all VRFs) and route entries in ASIC_DB.

panels.title: Config conflicts
panels.description: Pending CONFIG_DB changes to Nix-enforced keys (/run/sonic-nix/conflicts.json): they go away at the next boot/rebuild. Details: sonic-nix-diff on the switch.

panels.title: Data age
panels.description: Seconds since the sonic producer last succeeded (interval 30 s).

panels.title: Ports
panels.description: Every front-panel port: SONiC name and alias, admin/oper state (APPL_DB), speed, RX/TX rate (5 m, COUNTERS_DB), errors and discards in the time range, LLDP neighbor, module present.

panels.title: RX rate (admin-up ports)
panels.description: Received bits per second per admin-up port (COUNTERS_DB).

panels.title: TX rate (admin-up ports)
panels.description: Sent bits per second per admin-up port (COUNTERS_DB).

panels.title: Errors and discards
panels.description: RX+TX errors and discards per second, ports with any only.

panels.title: Oper state (admin-up ports)
panels.description: Oper up/down over time for admin-up ports.

panels.title: PortChannels
panels.description: CONFIG_DB PORTCHANNEL with teamsyncd's state (APPL_DB LAG_TABLE) and LACP-selected members (tlm_teamd).

panels.title: PortChannel members
panels.description: Selected: LACP selected the member (STATE_DB LAG_MEMBER_TABLE). Enabled: teamd passes traffic on it (APPL_DB LAG_MEMBER_TABLE).

panels.title: Members selected
panels.description: LACP selection over time.

panels.title: BGP neighbors

targets.expr: max by (vrf, neighbor, name, asn, local_addr, bfd) ((sonic_bgp_neighbor_state{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, vrf, neighbor) group_left (asn, local_addr, bfd) sonic_bgp_neighbor_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}) or (sonic_bgp_neighbor_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * 0 - 1))

max by (vrf, neighbor, name, asn, local_addr, bfd) (sonic_bgp_neighbor_admin_up{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, vrf, neighbor) group_left (asn, local_addr, bfd) sonic_bgp_neighbor_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.description: CONFIG_DB BGP_NEIGHBOR (all VRFs) with the session state bgpmon writes to STATE_DB NEIGH_STATE_TABLE. bgpmon reads the default VRF only: neighbors in other VRFs show "not reported" (check them with vtysh -c 'show bgp vrf all summary').

panels.title: BGP sessions
panels.description: Session state over time (RFC 4273 numbering, default VRF).

panels.title: BFD sessions

targets.expr: max by (vrf, interface, alias, peer, local_addr, type, multihop) (sonic_bfd_session_state{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, vrf, interface, peer) group_left (local_addr, type, multihop) sonic_bfd_session_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

max by (vrf, interface, alias, peer, local_addr, type, multihop) (sonic_bfd_session_tx_interval_seconds{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, vrf, interface, peer) group_left (local_addr, type, multihop) sonic_bfd_session_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

max by (vrf, interface, alias, peer, local_addr, type, multihop) (sonic_bfd_session_rx_interval_seconds{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, vrf, interface, peer) group_left (local_addr, type, multihop) sonic_bfd_session_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

max by (vrf, interface, alias, peer, local_addr, type, multihop) (sonic_bfd_session_detect_multiplier{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, vrf, interface, peer) group_left (local_addr, type, multihop) sonic_bfd_session_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.description: Software BFD (FRR bfdd) sessions as bfdsyncd writes them to STATE_DB BFD_SESSION_TABLE: BGP's (interface of the session) and static routes'. Interface "default": a session without interface.

panels.title: BFD sessions
panels.description: Session state over time (RFC 5880 numbering). Producer interval 30 s: a flap shorter than that may not show.

panels.title: LLDP neighbors

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (port, alias, remote_system, remote_port, remote_port_desc, remote_chassis) (sonic_lldp_neighbor_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "n", "$1", "port", "[A-Za-z]+([0-9]+)")

panels.description: APPL_DB LLDP_ENTRY_TABLE (lldp_syncd): one neighbor per port, the management port included.

panels.title: Transceivers

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (port, alias, type, vendor, model) (sonic_transceiver_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "n", "$1", "port", "[A-Za-z]+([0-9]+)")

label_replace(max by (port, alias, type, vendor, model) (sonic_transceiver_temperature_celsius{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, port) group_left (type, vendor, model) sonic_transceiver_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "n", "$1", "port", "[A-Za-z]+([0-9]+)")

label_replace(max by (port, alias, type, vendor, model) (sonic_transceiver_voltage_volts{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, port) group_left (type, vendor, model) sonic_transceiver_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}), "n", "$1", "port", "[A-Za-z]+([0-9]+)")

panels.description: Modules xcvrd reports (STATE_DB TRANSCEIVER_INFO / TRANSCEIVER_DOM_SENSOR). A breakout cage's module shows on each of its ports. Lane-level DDM: the Switch optics dashboard.

panels.title: Module temperature
panels.description: DOM temperature per module (xcvrd).

panels.title: LLDP neighbors and modules
panels.description: Counts over time: a cable or module change shows as a step.

panels.title: ACL rules

targets.expr: max by (table, rule, action, priority) (sonic_acl_rule_active{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, table, rule) group_left (action, priority) sonic_acl_rule_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

max by (table, rule, action, priority) (sonic_acl_rule_packets_total{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, table, rule) group_left (action, priority) sonic_acl_rule_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

max by (table, rule, action, priority) (sonic_acl_rule_bytes_total{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, table, rule) group_left (action, priority) sonic_acl_rule_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

max by (table, rule, action, priority) (rate(sonic_acl_rule_packets_total{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"}[5m]) * on (job, instance, table, rule) group_left (action, priority) sonic_acl_rule_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.description: CONFIG_DB ACL_RULE with orchagent's status (STATE_DB ACL_RULE_TABLE) and counters (COUNTERS_DB; only while "counterpoll acl enable" is on, off by default).

panels.title: ACL rule matches
panels.description: Packets per second matched per rule.

defaults.noValue: no ACL counters (counterpoll acl is off by default)

panels.title: CoPP groups

targets.expr: max by (group, trap_action, queue, meter_type, mode) (sonic_copp_group_cir{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, group) group_left (trap_action, queue, meter_type, mode) sonic_copp_group_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

max by (group, trap_action, queue, meter_type, mode) (sonic_copp_group_cbs{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, group) group_left (trap_action, queue, meter_type, mode) sonic_copp_group_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

max by (group, trap_action, queue, meter_type, mode) (sonic_copp_group_traps{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"} * on (job, instance, group) group_left (trap_action, queue, meter_type, mode) sonic_copp_group_info{job="$job",instance=~"$instance"})

panels.description: Trap groups as coppmgrd installs them (APPL_DB COPP_TABLE): CPU queue, action, policer rate. Traps of disabled features are not installed.

panels.title: CoPP traps
panels.description: Trap -> group.

panels.title: Trapped to the CPU
panels.description: Packets per second per trap (flex counter FLOW_CNT_TRAP).

panels.title: Routes
panels.description: APPL_DB ROUTE_TABLE (what fpmsyncd hands orchagent) per VRF and family, and ASIC_DB route entries (what reached syncd).

panels.title: Config conflicts
panels.description: Pending conflicts with the Nix configuration by CONFIG_DB table (sonic-nix-diff lists them).

panels.title: Services
panels.description: sonic-*.service and redis-sonic.service. Restarts: systemd NRestarts (automatic restarts since the last manual start). Starts (range): every new start seen, including restarts cascaded by BindsTo/Upholds (syncd -> everything below it).

panels.title: Unit starts
panels.description: New starts per unit (bars), restarts included.

panels.title: Producer
panels.description: sonic-metrics run time and collectors that failed to read their source (see journalctl -u prometheus-textfile-sonic).
